notes: Mobile Harness Code — independent fork of Mobile Harness. v1.6.0: local password-protected account so you can move to a new phone without losing anything. Create an account with a master password (never stored or sent anywhere) and back up; the encrypted .mhbackup now also carries your signing keystore, so restoring on a new phone brings back projects, chats, settings, API keys, Linux logins and signing keys. This APK is SIGNED (V3-only, production key); install mobile-harness-online.apk.
